device.description: 10-bit single-channel voltage-output DAC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: dac101s101.pdf (SNAS321G) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.10 serial timing diagram (Figure 2), p.18 power-on reset and power-down modes (Table 1), p.19 serial interface and input shift register (Figure 36), p.20 68HC11 interface (CPOL 0, CPHA 1)

commands.name: Write
commands.note: DB15:DB14 don't care, DB13:DB12 PD1:PD0 (00 normal, 01 1 kOhm, 10 100 kOhm, 11 Hi-Z), then the data

pages: p.3 (pins), p.5 (ROC: VA 2.7-5.5 V), p.10 (timing), p.18 (power-on reset, Table 1), p.19 (serial interface, Figure 36 X X PD1 PD0 D9..D0 X X), p.20 (68HC11 CPOL/CPHA)
notModeled: analog output (VA is both the supply and the reference), power-down output terminations and wake-up time
the write executes on the 16th SCLK falling edge (commit now); SYNC rising before it resets the shift register and the write is ignored; further SCLKs are ignored
SCLK and SYNC timing limits; digital inputs limited to VA + 0.1 V (no 5.5-V tolerance)
variants: DAC101S101-Q1 (SOT only) in the same datasheet; DAC081S101 (8-bit) and DAC121S101 (12-bit) are pin-compatible
